transcript: There are four things you must stop doing if you want to reduce anxiety and stress. First, stop regretting the past. What is done is done. Regret is just the mind trying to rewrite a story that has already been printed. Take the lesson and walk forward. Second, stop worrying about the future. The future is a shadow that has not yet formed. Trust yourself. You have survived every day so far. Third, stop searching for happiness in other people. Peace is not something someone gives you. It is something you remember within yourself. And fourth, stop underestimating your strength. You are far more resilient than you think. Every setback was training. Every loss shaped you. If these words felt familiar, it means you're ready to go deeper. Comment peace below, and I'll send you a free guide. Make sure you follow me, or I won't be able to message you. Walk gently. I'll see you there.
